title: Keyword filter fields (has_keyword, not_keyword, etc.) are String — no type distinguishing keyword from arbitrary string
description: EmailFilterCondition has has_keyword, not_keyword, all_in_thread_have_keyword, some_in_thread_have_keyword, none_in_thread_have_keyword — all Option<String>. The keyword constants in keyword.rs are &str constants, but passing an arbitrary String where a keyword is expected is not caught. A newtype Keyword(String) with validation (must match keyword syntax per RFC 8621 §4.1.1) would make invalid states unrepresentable and allow the keyword constants to be typed. Minimal change: the newtype can round-trip as a plain JSON string (same wire format). Callers using the constants would write Keyword::from(keyword::SEEN) rather than keyword::SEEN.to_owned().
notes: API-breaking change: adds Keyword newtype, changes filter fields from Option<String> to Option<Keyword>. Deferred to next semver bump (0.2.0).
